# octoreview-php

> Official PHP SDK for Octoreview: multi-tenant reviews, ratings and review media. Part of the octoverse family, modelled on octonomy. Status: the client core and every
> REST operation are in; uploads, webhooks and the integration suite are next; release line 1 in
> progress.

Gates: `make check` (fast, toolchain only) and `make release-check` (full). `make help` lists
every target.

## Docs

- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): product rules, gates and the development pipeline
- [README](README.md)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): layout, parameters, the contract gate and retries
- [Release runbook](docs/release.md)
- [Versioning policy](docs/versioning.md)
- [Rulesets](.github/rulesets/README.md): the live rulesets' reviewable mirror

## Code

- [Client](src/Client.php): construction, `fromEnv()` and the resource accessors
- [Operation table](src/Operations.php): every REST operation, its retry class and parameters
- [Transport](src/Transport.php): parameter checks, headers, retries and errors
- [Contract gate](tests/ContractTest.php): the checks against the vendored server contract
- [Vendored contract](testdata/contract/SOURCE): the server commit the contract gate checks against
